note: Adapted on ingestion (2026-06-15) to this project's architecture: packaging is done by scripts (vault-vpk-builder for the all-in-one VPK; package_client.js for client distributions), and ALL API calls go through the authenticated vault_api.js gateway. No sessionId is collected in-conversation. Deployment is gated on vault_api auth. Scripts are Node/JS (no Python runtime).

evals.name: package-all-in-one-vpk
evals.prompt: Build a deployable VPK for my feature (it has both a Java PageController under server/ and a React custom page under client/). I just want the package — I'll deploy it myself later.
evals.expected_output: Uses vault-vpk-builder (node .agents/skills/vault-vpk-builder/scripts/vpk.js <NAME>) to produce one all-in-one .vpk under toolbox/vpk/packages/. Does NOT attempt to deploy. Reports the .vpk path.
assertions: Packages via vault-vpk-builder's vpk.js, not a hand-built or javasdk-only VPK
Auto-detects that both client and server code are present and packages them together
Does not call any vault_api deploy command (user asked to package only)
Reports the resulting .vpk path under toolbox/vpk/packages/

evals.name: auth-gate-decline
evals.prompt: Deploy my custom page to my Vault.
evals.expected_output: Runs `node .agents/scripts/vault_api.js status` first. If not authenticated, asks whether the user wants to authenticate. If the user declines, packages the artifact only and stops, telling them how to deploy later. Never prompts for a raw sessionId on the command line as the primary path.
assertions: Runs vault_api.js status before any deploy
If not authenticated, offers to authenticate via vault_api auth
If auth is declined, packages only and does not deploy
Does not collect a sessionId into the conversation/command line as its own auth mechanism

evals.name: vpk-import-deploy-pipeline
evals.prompt: I'm authenticated to my dev sandbox via vault_api. Import and deploy toolbox/vpk/packages/MY-FEATURE.vpk.
evals.expected_output: Drives the vault_api pipeline: import-package --file ... → job-status --id <import_job> --wait → vql lookup of vault_package__v id → (warn about Configuration Mode) → deploy-package --id <pkg> → job-status --id <deploy_job> --wait. Surfaces final SUCCESS/failure and log location.
assertions: Uses vault_api import-package with the .vpk as payload
Polls the import job with job-status --wait
Looks up package_id via a vql query on vault_package__v (id, name__v, created_date__v only)
Warns that Configuration Mode is recommended before deploy
Uses vault_api deploy-package then polls the deploy job
Defaults to incremental deployment; does not silently use replace_all/delete_all

evals.name: client-direct-deploy
evals.prompt: Just push my custom page client bundle and register the Page — no full VPK. I'm authenticated.
evals.expected_output: package_client.js builds + zips the bundle (dist/ prefix) and generates page.mdl, then vault_api upload-distribution uploads the zip, then vault_api execute-mdl runs the Page MDL (upload BEFORE execute). Surfaces the absolute page URL.
assertions: Packages with package_client.js (no network in the packaging step)
Zip keeps the dist/ prefix matching distribution-manifest.json
Uploads via vault_api upload-distribution before executing the Page MDL
Runs the Page MDL via vault_api execute-mdl
